candidate.sense: The edible purple vegetable also called aubergine.

claims.proposition: In Indonesian, “terong” refers to eggplant as a vegetable.
“Terong” is commonly used for eggplant in Indonesia.
“Terong” is a normal everyday Indonesian form, alongside the spelling variant “terung.”
Terung denotes the edible vegetable known in English as eggplant or aubergine.
Terung is commonly used and understood in Malaysia for eggplant.
Terung is the normal Malaysian Malay spelling and everyday term; terong is associated with Indonesian usage.
Indonesian terong and Malaysian terung are commonly used for the same eggplant sense, with different spellings.

context.scope: Common concrete household and food objects with clear single-sense English cues; prioritize recognizably different Indonesian and Malaysian spellings or clearly preferred everyday terms; avoid concepts in existing batches

source_leads.exact_claim_to_check: The entry for “terong” gives the eggplant sense and may cross-reference “terung.”
The entry for “terung” indicates its relationship to “terong” or defines the same vegetable.

source_leads: Kamus Dewan entry for terung (DBP); Malaysian supermarket or produce listings for terung; Indonesian dictionary entry for terong for spelling contrast

prompt:
# Audit external evidence (prompt set 1.0.0)

Independently inspect every proposed source or corpus result. A model citation, URL, or dictionary
entry by itself is only a lead. For each observation, state exactly which claim is supported,
contradicted, or left inconclusive. Record the access method, page location or reproducible query,
short observed content, access time, publisher, underlying source group, locale, register, and
limitations. Count mirrors and copied pages as one underlying source. A dictionary listing proves
existence or a sense, not normal everyday preference by itself. Report contrary evidence.

Return JSON only: `{"schema_version":1,"role":"evidence-audit","model":"MODEL/TOOL",
"result":{"observations":[{"evidence_id":"...","claim_id":"...","source_group":"...",
"source_title":"...","publisher":"...","url_or_query":"...","accessed_at":"ISO UTC",
"observation":"...","page_location_or_query":"...",
"audit_method":"retrieved-page|corpus-query|manual-inspection",
"stance":"supports|contradicts|inconclusive","claim_type":"meaning|locale-usage|preferred-choice|relation|misleading-contrast",
"usage_basis":"contextual|comparative|dictionary-only","locale":"...","register":"...",
"limitations":"..."}]}}`.
If a source cannot be inspected, omit it from supporting observations and report the failure.
